title: Robots in the City: Persona-Based Perceptions of Urban Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.05954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pedestrians increasingly encounter robots in urban public spaces without interacting with them, but how robots change the perceived safety of a street remains unclear. We examine how robot presence and type affect perceived safety across urban contexts. We generate 18 images of Seoul streets that vary in time of day, road class, and robot condition (no robot, a delivery robot, or a humanoid). Two multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma4-26B, each conditioned on 500 synthetic personas, choose the safer image in each pair, and 25 human respondents complete the same task. Both models prefer streets without robots and favor the delivery robot over the humanoid. Robots are chosen more often at night and less often by older personas, whereas road class has smaller effects. translated_title: 城市中的机器人：基于人物角色的城市机器人感知
translated_abstract: 行人越来越多地在不与之互动的情况下在城市公共空间中遇到机器人，但机器人如何改变街道的安全感知仍不清楚。我们研究了机器人的存在及其类型如何影响不同城市情境下的安全感知。我们生成了18张首尔街道图像，这些图像在时间段、道路等级和机器人条件（无机器人、配送机器人或人形机器人）上各不相同。两个多模态大语言模型（MLLM），Qwen3.8-27B 和 Gemma4-26B，各自被设定了500个合成人物角色，在每一对图像中选择更安全的一张，同时25名人类受访者完成相同的任务。两个模型都更偏好没有机器人的街道，并且相比人形机器人更偏好配送机器人。机器人在夜间被选择的频率更高，年长的人物角色选择机器人的频率更低，而道路等级的影响较小。在模型的解释中，配送机器人被视为一种物理障碍物，而人形机器人则被视为威胁或保护的来源。
tldr: 该研究通过为多模态大语言模型设定500个合成人物角色来评估首尔街道图像的安全感知，发现模型与人类均偏好无机器人的街道、更接受配送机器人而非人形机器人，且机器人对安全感知的影响随时间段和人群年龄而变化。
en_tdlr: This study uses multimodal LLMs conditioned on 500 synthetic personas to assess perceived safety of Seoul street images, finding that both models and humans prefer robot-free streets and favor delivery robots over humanoids, with robot acceptance varying by time of day and persona age.
